title: The property messaged you - re-enter your card
scenario: Through the booking platform's own messaging system, 'the property' says there was a payment issue and asks you to re-enter your card details on a linked page to keep your reservation.

answers.A: Re-enter your card through the link since the message came through the platform.
answers.B: Re-enter your card, and also send a photo of it for verification.
answers.C: Contact the platform's official support directly instead of using the link in the message.

explanation: Compromised host accounts are used to message guests through the real platform, making the request look legitimate - the platform itself never asks for card details through a chat link.
proTip: A message coming through the real app doesn't guarantee the request inside it is real.
